description:
We are recruiting a Supply Chain Manager on behalf of our client, a dynamic manufacturing company operating in an international group environment.

You will play a strategic role in SIOP, supplier development, cost control, and team capability building, acting as the Supply Chain representative within Factory Management and Global Supply Chain governance.

 

Key Responsibilities

Delivery & Planning:

  • Ensure Delivery On Time performance;
  • Lead Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SIOP);
  • Optimize customer lead times and inventory levels (DIO);
  • Manage key suppliers according to Technical Purchase Specifications;
  • Oversee Order Handling and forecast processes.

Quality:

  • Drive Zero Defect culture within Supply Chain and supplier base;
  • Lead supplier development and improvement plans;
  • Ensure compliance with group purchasing standards;
  • Manage structured problem-solving and continuous improvement.

Cost & Performance:

  • Reduce COGS and optimize working capital;
  • Maintain full visibility on WIP and inventory;
  • Lead cost optimization initiatives;
  • Manage workforce flexibility and resource planning. 

People Leadership:

  • Build and develop a high-performing Supply Chain team;
  • Drive empowerment, coaching, and succession planning;
  • Promote a continuous improvement mindset (Kaizen, 5S, Problem Solving);
  • Ensure compliance with job descriptions, certifications, and development plans.

 Safety (EHS):

  • Promote a zero-injury culture;
  • Ensure compliance with site and group EHS standards.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Minimum 5 years of Supply Chain Management experience;
  • 3–5 years of purchasing experience (strategic, tactical & operational);
  • Strong negotiation skills with suppliers and service providers;
  • Education in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration or Supply Chain;
  • Solid leadership and people development experience;
  • Experience in metal or automotive industry is a strong advantage;
  • Advanced English (written & spoken);
  • Strong commercial understanding and cost awareness;
  • Experience with ERP systems (preferably AX).

 

If you are a proactive leader with strong analytical skills and a commitment to operational excellence, we invite you to apply or contact us for more information.
